On Aug 18, 2022, at 5:09 PM, Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Fabulous! One of the things that I want to do is get funding for a really good socialmedia analytics capability, both to
address risk and also for programming. I'm going to ask Logically Al to do a demo and Zignal Labs. Both are very good.
On Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 4:59 PM John Voorhees <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Vera -
Brian McGill (Deputy DIR SEC) will be the person to represent SEC in these forums.
Also ... we are in the process of bringing on a specialized contract disinformation Intel analyst to help bring in IC
products/information into the Agency and help us have a better operational picture of what is occurring.
I hope to do this quickly -- before the end of next month, but OCT at the latest.
R/ John
On Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 8:00 AM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear All,
We look forward to seeing you on Friday with DA Coleman, where we will discuss the Agency's
efforts to address disinformation. By way of background and for those who I have not had a
chance to meet yet,joined the DRG Center about three months ago as the Senior Advisor for
Tech and Democracy to help lead the Agency's efforts on digital democracy and combating
mis/dis/malinformation.
The purpose of this meeting will be to begin a discussion on how the Agency can better
respond to the ever growing threat of disinformation, and share more information about the
"Information Resilience Council" we are seeking to stand up. The Administrator has urged us to
explore such a Council as quickly as possible, and you will all receive an Action Memo for
clearance in the next week or two proposing its basic parameters. After initial introductions and
opening remarks from DA Coleman, I will provide an overview of key lines of effort and
initiatives we hope this Council will take on and coordinate across the Agency. We will then
open the floor to your insights and questions.
As this process gets underway, we would like to request your input on the following items:
• Please ID a senior level POC (either you or a DAA) to attend roughly bimonthly
senior level meetings like this one.
[opaque block] 13/15
